The issuer demonstrates solid profitability with revenue of 1,823M, an operating income of 371M (20% margin), and positive net income of 67M. However, its financial profile is constrained by high leverage (total liabilities of 7,240M against total assets of 10,153M, representing a debt-to-equity ratio of approximately 2.5x) and weak short-term liquidity, as evidenced by a current ratio of 0.55 (current assets of 475M vs. current liabilities of 857M). This combination of stable operating profitability alongside elevated leverage and liquidity pressure is characteristic of a mid-investment grade to high-yield transition rating.

DECISION: BBB-
